name: jp.wariwari/wariwari
title: wariwari
description: Split shared expenses in groups: add expenses, check balances and settle up, in 150+ currencies.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Use this to identify the connected wariwari account.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use this first when the user names a group, a person or an expense without its token. Searches every group the user belongs to by group name, member name, expense description or category, or by an exact amount ("7000", "¥7,000", "12.50") or ISO date ("2026-05-22"). A blank query returns the most recently active groups.

q.description:
Words from a group, member, expense or category name, an amount, or an
ISO date. Leave it out for the most recently active groups.

tools.name: list_groups
tools.description: Use this to list the user's groups with their tokens and currencies. Pass archived=true for archived groups.

archived.description: When true, lists the groups the user belongs to and has archived instead of their active set.

cursor.description: The `pagination.cursor` of the previous page. Opaque; pass it back unchanged.

tools.name: get_group
tools.description: Use this for who is in a group and who owes whom. Returns members with their tokens, each member's net balance per currency (positive = is owed, negative = owes), and the suggested payments that settle up. Expenses are not included; use list_transactions for those.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Use this to list a group's expenses and payments, newest first, optionally filtered by date range, category or participant token. Page with cursor.

from.description: Only transactions dated on or after this date.

to.description: Only transactions dated on or before this date.

categoryToken.description: Only transactions filed under this group category.

participantToken.description: Only transactions this participant paid for or owes a share of.

cursor.description: The `pagination.cursor` of the previous page. Opaque; pass it back unchanged.

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

tools.name: get_transaction
tools.description: Use this to read one expense or payment in full, including its splits and lockVersion.

transactionToken.description: The expense or payment's token, from `listTransactions` or `listSearchResults`.

tools.name: get_group_stats
tools.description: Use this for spending totals, per-category and per-member breakdowns, the largest expenses and spending over time. Amounts are minor units in the group currency.

dateRange.description: The period to count, relative to today in Japan. Defaults to `all_time`.

participantToken.description: Only expenses this participant paid for or owes a share of.

categoryToken.description: Only expenses filed under this group category.

date.description: Only expenses on this ISO date.

month.description: Filter to a single month, as `YYYY-MM`.

week.description: Filter to a Monday-start week containing the supplied ISO date.

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Use this to start a new group. List the other members by name: the user is added as a member under their account name, or linked to the member already named like it. Pick an emoji icon that fits the group, and ask which currency it settles in when the user hasn't said. Read the new group with get_group for its members' tokens.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

name.description: The group's name, such as a trip or a household.

icon.description: An emoji shown as the group's icon.

currency.description: Base currency. When omitted, the account's preferred currency, else the request country's, else USD for English and JPY otherwise.

creatorParticipantToken.description:
Token of the participant in `participants` who is creating the group.
With an account credential that participant is linked to the account as
admin and moved first. When omitted, the participant named like the
account is, or else a new one is added. Must match one of the supplied
participant tokens.

categories.description:
Optional complete initial category set for an offline-created duplicate.
When supplied, the server preserves these client tokens and does not add
its default categories. When omitted, the regular defaults are created.

token.description:
Optional client-generated token. When absent the server
generates one (`SecureRandom.base58(24)`).

name.description: The member's name, as the group sees it.

color.description: Avatar colour, or `null` for the default.

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

Color.description:
An avatar colour as an uppercase hex string. The server accepts only the
colours of its palette and answers 400 for any other; the palette can grow.

token.description: The category's token, chosen by the client.

position.description: Its place in the category list, 1 first.

tools.name: add_member
tools.description: Use this to add a person to a group by name.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

name.description: The member's name, as the group sees it.

color.description: Avatar colour, or `null` for the default.

Color.description:
An avatar colour as an uppercase hex string. The server accepts only the
colours of its palette and answers 400 for any other; the palette can grow.

tools.name: add_expense
tools.description: Use this to record an expense. amountCents is in minor units of currency (¥1,000 is 1000, $12.50 is 1250). paidByParticipantToken is who paid; splits lists who shares it. For an even split use splitType equal and omit amountCents from the splits. Take participant tokens from get_group or search, and default the date to today.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

description.description: What the expense was for, as the group will see it.

categoryToken.description: The group category to file it under, by token from `showGroup`. Omit for none.

amountCents.description: The total in minor units of `currency` (¥1,000 is 1000, $12.50 is 1250).

currency.description:
The currency it was paid in. One other than the group's is converted into
the group currency at the rate on `date`.

splitType.description:
How the total is divided. `equal` divides it for you; for any other type
each split carries its own `amountCents`.

timeOfDay.description: Time of day, `HH:MM` (24-hour). Omit for the time it is recorded, in Japan time.

paidByParticipantToken.description: The member who paid, by token from `showGroup`.

splits.description:
Who shares the expense. For `equal`, list the members and omit `amountCents`:
the server divides the total, odd cents to the first members in the group's
order. For `amount`, `percentage` and `shares`, give each member's
`amountCents`; they must add up to the total (exactly for `amount`, otherwise
within 1 per member).

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

SplitType.description:
How a transaction's amount is divided across participants.
  • `equal` — equal shares across all listed participants.
  • `percentage` — percentage shares (sum to 100, server normalizes
    rounding cents).
  • `shares` — weighted shares (e.g. 1, 2, 1 → 25/50/25 split).
  • `amount` — exact per-participant amounts supplied by the client.

SplitInput.description:
`amountCents` is each participant's share. With `splitType: equal`
it may be omitted from every split, and the server divides the
amount evenly (leftover cents go to the first participants). A split
of zero leaves that participant out; no zero split is stored.

participantToken.description: A member who shares the expense, by token from `showGroup`.

amountCents.description: This member's share in minor units of the expense's currency.

tools.name: update_expense
tools.description: Use this to change an expense. Send only the fields that change; expectedRevision is the lockVersion from get_transaction, and a stale one means someone else edited it, so read it again first. A new amountCents re-divides an equal split; for any other split type, send splits with the new amounts too.

transactionToken.description: The expense or payment's token, from `listTransactions` or `listSearchResults`.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

description.description: What the expense was for, as the group will see it.

categoryToken.description: Omit to keep the category; `null` clears it.

amountCents.description: The total in minor units of `currency` (¥1,000 is 1000, $12.50 is 1250).

currency.description:
Omit to keep it. One other than the group's is converted into the group
currency at the rate on `date`.

balanceCurrency.description:
Currency bucket used for balances. Omit to keep the current value, unless
the edit changes the amount or currency: then it moves to the group currency.
Only the group currency or the transaction's own `currency` is kept; any
other value (such as the group's previous currency) means the group currency.
Changing the group currency re-expresses balances without changing any
transaction's `lockVersion`.

splitType.description:
How the total is divided. `equal` divides it for you; for any other type
each split carries its own `amountCents`.

date.description: The day it was paid, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Omit to keep it.

timeOfDay.description: Time of day, `HH:MM` (24-hour). Omit to keep it.

paidByParticipantToken.description: The member who paid, by token from `showGroup`. Omit to keep it.

splits.description:
Who shares the expense, replacing every split. Omit to keep them: a new
total re-divides an `equal` split, any other type needs its splits resent.
For `equal`, list the members and omit `amountCents`: the server divides
the total, odd cents to the first members in the group's order. For
`amount`, `percentage` and `shares`, give each member's `amountCents`; they
must add up to the total (exactly for `amount`, otherwise within 1 per member).

  • `equal` — equal shares across all listed participants.
  • `percentage` — percentage shares (sum to 100, server normalizes

  • `shares` — weighted shares (e.g. 1, 2, 1 → 25/50/25 split).

of zero leaves that participant out; no zero split is stored.

participantToken.description: A member who shares the expense, by token from `showGroup`.

amountCents.description: This member's share in minor units of the expense's currency.

tools.name: delete_expense
tools.description: Use this to delete an expense or payment. expectedRevision is the lockVersion from get_transaction.

transactionToken.description: The expense or payment's token, from `listTransactions` or `listSearchResults`.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

tools.name: record_payment
tools.description: Use this when one member paid another back. fromParticipantToken paid toParticipantToken amountCents, in minor units. get_group's suggested payments say who should pay whom to settle up.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

toParticipantToken.description: The participant who received the payment.

description.description: Blank or omitted uses the default "From → To" label.

date.description: Defaults to today, or to the day in `Recorded-At`.

timeOfDay.description: Time of day, `HH:MM` (24-hour). Defaults to the time it is recorded, in Japan time.

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

tools.name: update_payment
tools.description: Use this to change a payment. Send only the fields that change, plus the lockVersion from get_transaction as expectedRevision.

transactionToken.description: The expense or payment's token, from `listTransactions` or `listSearchResults`.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

toParticipantToken.description: The participant who received the payment.

currency.description: Omit to keep the payment's currency.

description.description:
Omit to keep the current description. Blank resets it to the default
"From → To" label for the payment's participants.

date.description: Omit to keep the payment's date.

timeOfDay.description: Time of day, `HH:MM` (24-hour). Omit to keep the payment's time.

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the

generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

tools.name: bulk_edit_expenses
tools.description: Use this to set the same payer, category, split, date or time on several expenses at once. List each one in transactions with its token and, as expectedRevision, its lockVersion from list_transactions.

transactions.description: The transactions to change, all in this group. If one has moved past its revision, none change.

paidByParticipantToken.description: The member who paid every one of them, payments included, by token from `showGroup`.

categoryToken.description: The group category to file the expenses under, by token from `showGroup`. Payments keep none.

date.description: The day to move every one of them to, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

timeOfDay.description: The time of day to give every one of them, `HH:MM` (24-hour).

split.description: Who shares each expense; every expense's total is divided again. Payments are left as they are.

TransactionBatchItem.description: One transaction in a batch, with the revision the caller last saw.

expectedRevision.description: The transaction's `lockVersion` when the caller read it.

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

BatchSplit.description:
The people every expense is split between. Weights are percentages or share counts for
those split types; an equal split ignores them. Each new name joins the group as a member,
or reuses the member who already has it.

type.description: How each total is divided among `members`.

members.description: Members who share each expense. Give at least one, here or in `newMemberNames`.

newMemberNames.description:
More people to share each expense, by name. A name matching a member's
(ignoring case) uses that member; any other joins the group as a new one.

weight.description:
This member's percentage or number of shares. Each total is divided in
proportion to the weights, so percentages need not add up to 100.
Omitted is 1; an equal split ignores it.

tools.name: bulk_delete_expenses
tools.description: Use this to delete several expenses or payments at once. List each one in transactions with its token and, as expectedRevision, its lockVersion from list_transactions.

transactions.description: The transactions to delete, all in this group. If one has moved past its revision, none are deleted.

TransactionBatchItem.description: One transaction in a batch, with the revision the caller last saw.

expectedRevision.description: The transaction's `lockVersion` when the caller read it.

Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server

tools.name: get_expense_history
tools.description: Use this to see who created or changed one expense or payment, and what changed, newest first.

transactionToken.description: The expense or payment's token, from `listTransactions` or `listSearchResults`.

cursor.description: The `pagination.cursor` of the previous page. Opaque; pass it back unchanged.

tools.name: get_group_history
tools.description: Use this to see recent changes to a group's expenses and payments, newest first. Page with cursor.

cursor.description: The `pagination.cursor` of the previous page. Opaque; pass it back unchanged.

tools.name: get_member_balance
tools.description: Use this to explain why a member owes or is owed: their balance in the group currency, expense by expense. Entries name transactions by token.

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Use this to rename a group, change its icon or currency, or change who can open it by link (visibility: public_editable, public_view_only, or private_registered for members only). A new currency converts existing expenses in the background, so read an expense again before editing it. expectedRevision is the group's lockVersion from get_group, whose viewerAccess says what the user may change.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

icon.description: A new emoji for the group's icon.

currency.description:
New base currency. Existing transactions are rebased onto it in the
background, which bumps their `lockVersion`: re-read a transaction
before updating or deleting it after a currency change. Needs
`viewerAccess.canManageSettings`.

visibility.description:
Who can open the group by link. Needs `viewerAccess.canManageAccess`.
A restricted group needs a linked admin; the caller becomes one when
the group has none.

Visibility.description:
Who can open and edit the group by link. `public_editable` lets anyone
with the link edit, `public_view_only` lets them view, and
`private_registered` limits access to linked members.

tools.name: duplicate_group
tools.description: Use this to start a new group with the same categories, and the same members unless includeMembers is false. Expenses are not copied.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Use this to delete a group for everyone in it. expectedRevision is the group's lockVersion from get_group. To only take it off the user's own list, use archive_group or leave_group instead.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

tools.name: leave_group
tools.description: Use this to remove a group from the user's list and unlink them from their member, which stays as a guest. The group and its expenses stay for everyone else. The last admin of a private or view-only group can't leave.

tools.name: get_notification_settings
tools.description: Use this to check whether the user has muted push notifications for a group.

tools.name: update_notification_settings
tools.description: Use this to mute or unmute push notifications for a group, for the user only.

muted.description: When true, this member receives no push notifications for the group.

tools.name: archive_group
tools.description: Use this to hide a group from the user's group list. Only the user's own list changes.

tools.name: unarchive_group
tools.description: Use this to bring an archived group back to the user's group list.

tools.name: update_member
tools.description: Use this to rename a guest or change their colour, or to change the role (admin, editor, read_only) of a member linked to an account. expectedRevision is the member's lockVersion from get_group.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

color.description: Avatar colour, or `null` for the default.

membershipRole.description:
Only for a participant linked to an account; a role for a guest is a
400. Needs `viewerAccess.canManageAccess`. A restricted group keeps at
least one admin.

Color.description:
An avatar colour as an uppercase hex string. The server accepts only the
colours of its palette and answers 400 for any other; the palette can grow.

tools.name: move_member
tools.description: Use this to move a member to a position in the group's member list, or one step up or down.

position.description: The member's new place in the list, 1 first. Past the end, nothing moves.

tools.name: remove_member
tools.description: Use this to remove a member from a group. expectedRevision is the member's lockVersion from get_group.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

tools.name: merge_members
tools.description: Use this when two members are the same person. participantToken is the duplicate: their expenses and payments move to intoParticipantToken and the duplicate is removed. expectedRevision is the duplicate's lockVersion from get_group. This cannot be undone.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the

tools.name: claim_member
tools.description: Use this when the user says they are one of a group's members, to link that member to their account. If the user is already linked to another member, the two are merged.

tools.name: add_category
tools.description: Use this to add an expense category to a group, with an emoji and a name.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

emoji.description: An emoji shown beside the category's name.

name.description: The category's name, such as Food or Rent.

position.description:
Its place in the category list, 1 first; omit to put it last. Only this category's number
changes: categories on the same number keep the order they were added in.

tools.name: update_category
tools.description: Use this to rename a category, change its emoji or move it. expectedRevision is the category's lockVersion from get_group.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

emoji.description: A new emoji for the category.

position.description:
Its place in the category list, 1 first. Only this category's number
changes: categories on the same number keep the order they were added in.

tools.name: delete_category
tools.description: Use this to delete a category no expense uses. expectedRevision is the category's lockVersion from get_group.

expectedRevision.description: The `lockVersion` the client last saw on the record it is changing. A mismatch is `409 CONFLICT` with the record as the server now has it.

tools.name: list_invitations
tools.description: Use this to list a group's invitation links that can still be used. Admins only.

tools.name: create_invitation
tools.description: Use this to create an invitation link to a view-only or private group, as an admin, editor or read_only member, and give the user its url to share. A public_editable group needs no invitation: share its shareUrl from get_group, or make it private first with update_group. Admins only.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

membershipRole.description: Role granted to whoever accepts. Defaults to editor.

expiresAt.description: When the invitation stops working; a time in the past is a 400. Omit for one that never expires.

tools.name: revoke_invitation
tools.description: Use this to cancel an invitation link, by its token from list_invitations. Admins only.

tools.name: list_access_requests
tools.description: Use this to see who has asked to join a view-only or private group. Admins only.

tools.name: approve_access_request
tools.description: Use this to let someone who asked to join a group in as an editor. Admins only.

accessRequestId.description: The pending access request's id, from `listAccessRequests`.

tools.name: decline_access_request
tools.description: Use this to turn down a request to join a group. The person can ask again after 7 days. Admins only.

accessRequestId.description: The pending access request's id, from `listAccessRequests`.

tools.name: export_csv
tools.description: Use this to get every expense and payment in a group as CSV text, the same file the web app exports.

tools.name: get_fx_rate
tools.description: Use this to convert from another currency into the group currency, optionally on a past date.

date.description:
Day the rate is for, usually the expense's date. Defaults to today.
Today and later dates get the latest published rate.

tools.name: list_recurring_expenses
tools.description: Use this to list the expenses a group repeats on a schedule, with each one's next date. A paused schedule was set up by someone who no longer has Pro: its dates are skipped until they have it again.

tools.name: create_recurring_expense
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an expense added on a schedule, such as monthly rent. It is posted on startsOn and then every interval weeks, months or years; a startsOn in the past begins at the next date from today.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

description.description: What each expense is for, such as Rent.

amountCents.description: Each expense's total in minor units of `currency` (¥1,000 is 1000, $12.50 is 1250).

currency.description: The currency each expense is paid in.

categoryToken.description: The group category to file each expense under, by token from `showGroup`. Omit for none.

paidByParticipantToken.description: The member who pays each time, by token from `showGroup`.

splitType.description: How each total is divided, and so which value every split carries.

interval.description: How many `cadence` units apart the expenses are, such as 2 with `weekly` for every other week.

startsOn.description:
The first date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, from which the schedule counts. The first
expense is posted on the first scheduled date from today on.

How a transaction's amount is divided across participants.

  • `shares` — weighted shares (e.g. 1, 2, 1 → 25/50/25 split).

Who shares each occurrence. `amountCents` is the share for `amount`

participantToken.description: A member who shares each expense, by token from `showGroup`.

amountCents.description: For an `amount` split, this member's share in minor units.

percentage.description: For a `percentage` split, this member's percentage.
